# Old Parchment Paper

Source: https://opengameart.org/content/old-parchment-paper

License: CC0.

The app uses `parchment_alpha.png` as the active FE-style flashcard material.
The importer scales the transparent paper over the generated Fire Emblem
background layer: transparent corners keep the background visible, and the
opaque center gives dark dialogue text a readable surface.

If this file is unavailable, the importer falls back to the OpenGameArt
Parchment GUI source, then the downloaded map-warning reference crop, then the
generated panel.
